verdicts.evidence: At the opening, Oboe 1 prints a 23-bar rest on page 1, staff 9 (measures 1–23), while Oboe 2 prints a 13-bar rest at the same place on page 1, staff 8 (measures 1–13). The app also reports a later reading at page 1, staff 10, bar 7 of 14 with alternative 4, but the comparison at the opening independently shows the part's printed rest is 10 bars longer than the other part's.
verdicts.note: Oboe 1, movement II, page 1 staff 9: the opening rest is printed as 23 bars rather than the 13 shown in Oboe 2, making subsequent rehearsal letters 10 bars late.

trace.summary: Oboe 1, movement II, has a 10-bar misprint: its opening rest on page 1, staff 9 is printed as 23 bars, while Oboe 2 shows 13 bars at the same place. This accounts for the 10-measure shift in the reported rehearsal letters; although a later count has an alternative app reading of 4, the opening comparison establishes the printed discrepancy.
